name.en: Unity Day at the Statue of Unity

timing.recurrence: Every 31 October — Sardar Patel's birth anniversary, marked nationally as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas

description: The statue's own festival: 31 October, Sardar Patel's birth anniversary, observed nationally as Unity Day with its centrepiece at Ekta Nagar. The morning brings the Ekta Diwas parade and ceremonial events — frequently with the Prime Minister in attendance — followed by cultural programmes through the day and the campus at its most polished. It is simultaneously the most spectacular and the most restricted day to visit: security tightens, sections close for VIP movements, and normal tourist flow bends around the ceremony.
crowd_impact: Expect security cordons, section closures and heavy traffic; hotels fill across Ekta Nagar and Rajpipla. Normal sightseeing is better the day after.
tips: Attend for the parade and atmosphere, not for a normal statue visit
Check official announcements — access arrangements change year to year
Book stays a month ahead for the late-October week
